assumptions: Index kits, color rules and hopping-rate classes are the vendor datasets as cached.
Distance is the metric named, as DNABarcodes computes it.
limits: Predicts demultiplexing risk; it does not demultiplex reads.
bio.jane/contract.question: Will this pool of sample indexes sequence: duplicates, length, pairwise distance, color balance and hopping risk?

description: Will this pool of sample indexes actually sequence? One verdict over the indexes a lab is about to load: duplicates, uniform length, the distance the set really guarantees against the distance it claims, per-cycle color balance on the chosen instrument's own chemistry, the index-2 orientation that instrument reads, and index-hopping exposure — how many i7 x i5 combinations exist against how many are in use, and which swaps would turn one sample's read into another's undetectably. Takes a pasted list or a vendor kit by id. It CHECKS a pool; design_barcodes builds one.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

i5_cycles.description: index-2 read length from the run recipe. 0 = use the indexes' own length.

i7_cycles.description: index-1 read length from the RUN RECIPE, when it differs from the index length — a 10 nt index read at 8 cycles is an 8 nt index for every purpose here. 0 = use the indexes' own length.

instrument.description: which instrument the run is on. It decides the chemistry the color balance is judged under AND the orientation index 2 is read in — a pool balanced on a NovaSeq 6000 is not balanced on a NovaSeq X.

kit.description: a vendor kit id instead of a pasted list — the kit's own indexes are resolved and checked. Ignored when `pool` is given. Values:  (No kit — paste a list instead), truseq-single-indexes (TruSeq Single Indexes — Illumina, 24 indexes), truseq-cd-indexes (TruSeq DNA and RNA CD Indexes — Illumina, 96 indexes), idt-truseq-ud-indexes (IDT for Illumina–TruSeq DNA and RNA UD Indexes — Illumina / IDT, 100 indexes), idt-illumina-ud-plate-a (IDT for Illumina UD Indexes, Plate A/Set 1 — Illumina / IDT, 96 indexes), idt-illumina-ud-plate-b (IDT for Illumina UD Indexes, Plate B/Set 2 — Illumina / IDT, 96 indexes), idt-illumina-ud-plate-c (IDT for Illumina UD Indexes, Plate C/Set 3 — Illumina / IDT, 98 indexes), idt-illumina-ud-plate-d (IDT for Illumina UD Indexes, Plate D/Set 4 — Illumina / IDT, 100 indexes). Only applies when pool is not given.

library_prep.description: which of Illumina's published hopping-rate classes applies. The check multiplies the published RANGE by what this pool can throw away, to report how much is unrecoverable — it never predicts a rate for your run. Values: patterned-examp (Patterned flow cell, ExAmp chemistry), truseq-pcr-free (TruSeq PCR-Free libraries).

metric.description: error model the distance guarantee is measured under — a pool safe under substitutions may be unsafe under indels. Values: hamming (Hamming (substitutions)), seqlev (Sequence-Levenshtein (indels)), levenshtein (Levenshtein).

pool.description: the pool as text — one row per sample: `name<TAB>i7[<TAB>i5]`, or bare index sequences one per line, with or without a header. Rows that cannot be read are REPORTED with their line number, never dropped.

required_distance.description: the minimum distance the pool is SUPPOSED to guarantee, if it was designed to one — the check says whether it does. 0 = report the distance without judging it. Advanced.

name: check_index_pool

checks.description: every check with its own result — a check with no input to run against reports SKIPPED, never passed

closestPairs.description: the pairs that get confused first

failures.description: checks that FAILED — a warn and a skip are each counted by their own status in `checks`, never folded in here

guarantee.description: how many errors this pool can CORRECT and DETECT under the chosen metric — the number the whole check exists to establish

hopping.description: index-hopping exposure: combinations possible against combinations in use, the removable share, and the undetectable swaps

reads.description: per index read: cycles, color-balance tier and the per-cycle channel census

skipped.description: rows the parse could not read, each with its line number and the reason — these are usually WHY a check refused
